dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Knights of Favonius. How may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: This is the main hall on the ground floor of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters. On this floor you can find the library and the Grand Master's Office.

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: If you have any questions, feel free to ask me at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One of these doors is locked...

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: Ah, that room's not open to outsiders.

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: Well, it doesn't involve some internal secret of the Knights of Favonius or anything. That room is actually solitary confinement.

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: To be honest, this room has more or less become Klee's private property...

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: Every time she's locked in there, you can hear some crackling noises, like she's researching new explosives in there...

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: I'm sure that she won't ignite any of her bombs in here, but if she ever slips up...

dialogues.speaker: Wood
dialogues.text: I hope you find what you need here.
